phases.name: Phase 1: Kick-Off

checks.why: Roles are assigned to HubSpot contacts on the dashboard, not in the instance.
Documents are recorded on the dashboard (uploaded or linked).

checks.rule: A company logo is uploaded AND the brand colors differ from the Allmoxy default.
checks.on_fail: not_started if no logo and default colors; in_progress if only one of the two.

checks.rule: The page shows saved values that are not the out-of-the-box defaults.
checks.on_fail: needs_human (defaults can be a deliberate choice).

checks.rule: At least one price adjustment / pricing tier exists.
checks.on_fail: not_started if the list is empty.
checks.also: The dashboard shows the customer's 'Pricing and price adjustments' document link beside this step.

checks.rule: A payment gateway shows as connected.
At least one payment term exists.
A custom domain is set for the ordering portal.
The first 10 orders ever created in the instance are the validation orders. List them oldest first (order number, name, date, status). 10 found = done; fewer = in_progress with the count.
checks.on_fail: in_progress (n of 10), or not_started if no orders.

checks.why: Agreed on a call, not a setting.

checks.rule: Three or more active triggers beyond the defaults.
MORE THAN ONE shipping method or rate. Will Call alone means shipping is not set up.
checks.on_fail: not_started if none or only Will Call.

checks.rule: QuickBooks, Xero or another accounting system shows as connected.
An API key or a webhook exists.
At least one production line / process is set up.

checks.why: A decision made with the customer.

checks.rule: Count real orders in Verified, Completed or Shipped (also check /orders/#status_catalog=Completed and =Shipped). 10 or more = done.
checks.on_fail: in_progress with the count (n of 10), not_started if none.

checks.rule: Five or more customer companies have portal logins.
Operator is in use: settings or the page show usage/activity.
checks.on_fail: not_started if locked, an upsell page, or no usage.

checks.rule: More than two imports have been run.
New inventory items were created, or supplies have moved (transactions / stock changes).
checks.on_fail: not_started if locked/upsell or no activity.

checks.rule: The scanner page loads with data in use.
The activity log shows new triggers created since the customer went live.
checks.on_fail: not_started if none since go-live; needs_human if the log can't be read.

checks.why: A meeting, not in the instance.
